descriptions.description:
This dataset contains the national and gridded historical population data for ISIMIP3a (Frieler et al. 2023). Gridded estimates are available for total as well as urban and rural population counts.
Annual country-level population data for 249 countries are based on the historic population estimates provided by the UN World Population Prospects (United Nations, 2019). For the year 2021, we use the “medium variant” of the probabilistic forecast also provided by the WPP. The forecast accounts for the past experience of each country, while reflecting uncertainty about future changes based on the past experience of other countries under similar conditions (see United Nations, 2019, for details). For countries not covered in the database, estimates are taken from the MissingIslands dataset (Arujo et al., 2021) to finally provide population data for 249 countries.
In addition, we also provide gridded population data. For the past we used HYDE v3.3 (Klein Goldewijk et al. 2017, 2023, resolution 5arcmin) as the basis, while the projection data is based on Jones et al. (2020, resolution 30arcsec). Both data sets provide total, urban and rural populations. These maps were scaled such that the country-level population numbers are matched. In order to avoid grid cell shared by countries the scaling was performed on a 30 arcsec grid. To be able to do this the HYDE data were transferred to the high resolution grid by evenly spreading the population in a 5 arcmin grid cell on the underlying 30 arcsec land grid cells.
Once these steps were performed the maps were aggregated back to the 5arcmin, 15 arcmin and 30arcmin grids.
With version 1.1, we provided a first version of gridded population data, which was is based on HYDE v3.3.
Version 1.2 corrects a mistake in the coastal regions that led to a too high population in those grid cells.
Version 1.3 extends the national data to 1850. The additional years were derived from the gridded historic population map by means of the fractional ISIMIP country mask.
Version 1.4 adds the globally gridded population data as descibed above, along with country-level data stratified by age.
